### Create redis secret

```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const zone = tencentcloud.redis.getZoneConfig({
    typeId: 8,
});
const vpc = new tencentcloud.vpc.Instance("vpc", {
    name: "vpc-example",
    cidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
});
const subnet = new tencentcloud.subnet.Instance("subnet", {
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    availabilityZone: zone.then(zone => zone.lists?.[3]?.zone),
    name: "subnet-example",
    cidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
});
const example = new tencentcloud.redis.Instance("example", {
    availabilityZone: zone.then(zone => zone.lists?.[3]?.zone),
    typeId: zone.then(zone => zone.lists?.[3]?.typeId),
    password: "Qwer@234",
    memSize: zone.then(zone => zone.lists?.[3]?.memSizes?.[0]),
    redisShardNum: zone.then(zone => zone.lists?.[3]?.redisShardNums?.[0]),
    redisReplicasNum: zone.then(zone => zone.lists?.[3]?.redisReplicasNums?.[0]),
    name: "tf_example",
    port: 6379,
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    subnetId: subnet.id,
});
const exampleSecret = new tencentcloud.ssm.Secret("example", {
    secretName: "tf-example",
    description: "redis desc.",
    isEnabled: true,
    secretType: 4,
    additionalConfig: pulumi.jsonStringify({
        Region: "ap-guangzhou",
        Privilege: "r",
        InstanceId: example.id,
        ReadonlyPolicy: ["master"],
        Remark: "for tf test",
    }),
    tags: {
        createdBy: "terraform",
    },
    recoveryWindowInDays: 0,
});
```

```go
import (
	"encoding/json"

	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/redis"

	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/vpc"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		zone, err := redis.GetZoneConfig(ctx, &redis.GetZoneConfigArgs{
			TypeId: pulumi.IntRef(8),
		}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		vpc2, err := vpc.NewInstance(ctx, "vpc", &vpc.InstanceArgs{
			Name:      pulumi.String("vpc-example"),
			CidrBlock: pulumi.String("10.0.0.0/16"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		subnet2, err := subnet.NewInstance(ctx, "subnet", &subnet.InstanceArgs{
			VpcId:            vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			AvailabilityZone: pulumi.String(zone.Lists[3].Zone),
			Name:             pulumi.String("subnet-example"),
			CidrBlock:        pulumi.String("10.0.0.0/16"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		example, err := redis.NewInstance(ctx, "example", &redis.InstanceArgs{
			AvailabilityZone: pulumi.String(zone.Lists[3].Zone),
			TypeId:           pulumi.Int(zone.Lists[3].TypeId),
			Password:         pulumi.String("Qwer@234"),
			MemSize:          pulumi.Int(zone.Lists[3].MemSizes[0]),
			RedisShardNum:    pulumi.Int(zone.Lists[3].RedisShardNums[0]),
			RedisReplicasNum: pulumi.Int(zone.Lists[3].RedisReplicasNums[0]),
			Name:             pulumi.String("tf_example"),
			Port:             pulumi.Int(6379),
			VpcId:            vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			SubnetId:         subnet2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = ssm.NewSecret(ctx, "example", &ssm.SecretArgs{
			SecretName:  pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			Description: pulumi.String("redis desc."),
			IsEnabled:   pulumi.Bool(true),
```

```java
package generated_program;

import com.pulumi.Context;
import com.pulumi.Pulumi;
import com.pulumi.core.Output;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Redis.RedisFunctions;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Redis.inputs.GetZoneConfigArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Ssm.Secret;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Ssm.SecretArgs;
import static com.pulumi.codegen.internal.Serialization.*;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);
    }

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        final var zone = RedisFunctions.getZoneConfig(GetZoneConfigArgs.builder()
            .typeId(8)
            .build());

        var vpc = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.Instance("vpc", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .name("vpc-example")
            .cidrBlock("10.0.0.0/16")
            .build());

        var subnet = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Subnet.Instance("subnet", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Subnet.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .availabilityZone(zone.lists()[3].zone())
            .name("subnet-example")
            .cidrBlock("10.0.0.0/16")
            .build());

        var example = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Redis.Instance("example", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Redis.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .availabilityZone(zone.lists()[3].zone())
            .typeId(zone.lists()[3].typeId())
            .password("Qwer@234")
            .memSize(zone.lists()[3].memSizes()[0])
            .redisShardNum(zone.lists()[3].redisShardNums()[0])
            .redisReplicasNum(zone.lists()[3].redisReplicasNums()[0])
            .name("tf_example")
            .port(6379)
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .subnetId(subnet.id())
            .build());

        var exampleSecret = new Secret("exampleSecret", SecretArgs.builder()
            .secretName("tf-example")
            .description("redis desc.")
            .isEnabled(true)
            .secretType(4)
            .additionalConfig(example.id().applyValue(_id -> serializeJson(
                jsonObject(
                    jsonProperty("Region", "ap-guangzhou"),
                    jsonProperty("Privilege", "r"),
                    jsonProperty("InstanceId", _id),
                    jsonProperty("ReadonlyPolicy", jsonArray("master")),
                    jsonProperty("Remark", "for tf test")
                ))))
            .tags(Map.of("createdBy", "terraform"))
            .recoveryWindowInDays(0)
            .build());

    }
}
```

```hcl
}
resource "tencentcloud_redis_instance" "example" {
  availability_zone  = data.tencentcloud_redis_getzoneconfig.zone.lists[3].zone
  type_id            = data.tencentcloud_redis_getzoneconfig.zone.lists[3].type_id
  password           = "Qwer@234"
  mem_size           = data.tencentcloud_redis_getzoneconfig.zone.lists[3].mem_sizes[0]
  redis_shard_num    = data.tencentcloud_redis_getzoneconfig.zone.lists[3].redis_shard_nums[0]
  redis_replicas_num = data.tencentcloud_redis_getzoneconfig.zone.lists[3].redis_replicas_nums[0]
  name               = "tf_example"
  port               = 6379
  vpc_id             = tencentcloud_vpc_instance.vpc.id
  subnet_id          = tencentcloud_subnet_instance.subnet.id
}
resource "tencentcloud_ssm_secret" "example" {
  secret_name = "tf-example"
  description = "redis desc."
  is_enabled  = true
  secret_type = 4
  additional_config = jsonencode({
    "Region"         = "ap-guangzhou"
    "Privilege"      = "r"
    "InstanceId"     = tencentcloud_redis_instance.example.id
    "ReadonlyPolicy" = ["master"]
    "Remark"         = "for tf test"
  })
  tags = {
    "createdBy" = "terraform"
  }
  recovery_window_in_days = 0
}
```

## Import



SSM secret can be imported using the secretName, e.g.
```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Ssm/secret:Secret foo test
```

Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

* `secretName` - (Required, ForceNew) Name of secret which cannot be repeated in the same region. The maximum length is 128 bytes. The name can only contain English letters, numbers, underscore and hyphen '-'. The first character must be a letter or number.
* `description` - (Optional) Description of secret. The maximum is 2048 bytes.
* `kmsKeyId` - (Optional, ForceNew, Computed) KMS keyId used to encrypt secret. If it is empty, it means that the CMK created by SSM for you by default is used for encryption. You can also specify the KMS CMK created by yourself in the same region for encryption.
* `secretType` - (Optional, Computed) Type of secret. `0`: user-defined secret. `4`: redis secret. Default is `0`.
* `additionalConfig` - (Optional) Additional config for specific secret types in JSON string format.
* `encryptType` - (Optional, Computed) Encryption type of secret. `0`: KMS key encryption. `1`: soft key encryption. Default is `0`. Once created, it cannot be modified.
* `isEnabled` - (Optional) Specify whether to enable secret. Default value is `true`.
* `recoveryWindowInDays` - (Optional) Specify the scheduled deletion date. Default value is `0` that means to delete immediately. 1-30 means the number of days reserved, completely deleted after this date.
* `tags` - (Optional) Tags of secret.

Attributes Reference

The following attributes are exported:

* `status` - Status of secret.
* `id` - Secret name.



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
